description: This file is a shell script used for testing the trace2 facility within a Git environment. It contains test cases that validate the behavior and output of trace2 under various conditions, including different event types, return codes, error messages, and configuration settings. The script sets environment variables, prepares test environments, runs Git commands with tracing enabled, and verifies the output through detailed checks and scrubbing functions.

methods.name: scrub_normal
methods.description: A function that sanitizes trace2 output by replacing variable fields such as elapsed time, command paths, and other details with placeholders for comparison in tests.
